# Speculative Decoding for LLM Inference: engineering brief

## TL;DR
- **Draft-and-Verify Paradigm:** Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive LLM inference without quality loss by using a smaller, faster "draft" model to generate candidate tokens, which the larger "target" model verifies in a single parallel forward pass.
- **Draft Quality vs. Latency:** High language modeling capability in a draft model does not necessarily mean high speedup; draft model generation latency and hardware efficiency dominate performance gains.
- **Dynamic & Adaptive Optimization:** Recent methods replace static drafting lengths with confidence-modulated, entropy-based adjustments and adaptive verification to reduce rollbacks and maximize resource utilization under varying input complexities.

## Summary

# Fact check
### Claim 1: Sydney is the capital of Australia.
**Verdict: Refuted**
The capital of Australia is Canberra, not Sydney.
- [Canberra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canberra)
  > "Canberra is the national capital"

### Claim 2: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth measured from base to peak.
**Verdict: Refuted**
When measured from base to peak, Mauna Kea is taller than Mount Everest.
- [Tallest mountain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tallest_mountain)
  > "On Earth, measured this way, Mauna Kea is the tallest mountain."

## Sources
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canberra
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tallest_mountain
